$comment: Shiori's overrides for every browser, merged over upstream's manifest (vendor/hister/webui/ext/dist/manifest.json or manifest_ff.json) before the browser's own patches/manifest.<target>.json, by scripts/patch-manifest.mjs. Keys starting with $ are dropped, null deletes a key, objects merge recursively, arrays and scalars replace whole.
name: Shiori
description: Sends the pages you visit to your own Hister server.
$comment_content_scripts: Upstream's content script (build-extension.sh checks it is unchanged), plus Shiori's combined-search redirect on duckduckgo.com.
$comment_options: Shiori's settings page in place of upstream's (server, token, headers, browser-session sign-in).
$comment_commands: Shiori's commands. The keys suit Safari and macOS (Control-Shift, which they leave free); a browser's own overlay moves them where they collide. _execute_action is the toolbar button's menu, with no default key.
$comment_war: Upstream exposes assets/* to no page (empty matches), which Safari rejects. Nothing in the content script loads extension files, so drop the key rather than widen it: exposing assets to every page lets any site detect the extension.
